description: Apply VAT to a net amount, or with inclusive=true split a VAT-inclusive price (giá đã gồm VAT) into net (tiền hàng) and VAT. Rates 0/5/8/10/KCT/KKKNT. Net is rounded half away from zero and the leftover đồng goes to VAT (library convention).
name: vn_einvoice_vat
title: Apply or split VAT
